title: "Poetry env activate" doesn't get recognized in fish and bash shell unless command "poetry env use <python version> is run before.

labels.name: status/triage
labels.description: This issue needs to be triaged

body:
### Description

When using the new "poetry env activate" command, I get the following output:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/7f7000dc-da65-405e-abca-8bb8102b6981)

Expected output after running "poetry env use 3.12" at least once:

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e5d63b59-ef4a-4b97-9138-d2e861e8ba00)

The issue I take here is that on Windows PowerShell, the env use command is not necessary. Here, poetry Install is enough. 
Maybe it is expected behavior, but it is not consistent across platforms. 


### Workarounds

Run "poetry env use" <python version or environment path> beforehand.

### Poetry Installation Method

install.python-poetry.org

### Operating System

Fedora 41

### Poetry Version

Poetry (version 2.0.1)
